finding.comment: The script echoes the live DEPLOY_TOKEN to stderr; CI log capture leaks that credential to anyone with log access, defeating the env-only handling of the secret.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/ship.sh
+++ b/scripts/ship.sh
@@ -8,4 +8,5 @@
 set -euo pipefail
 : "${DEPLOY_TOKEN:?DEPLOY_TOKEN must be set}"
 : "${REGISTRY_URL:?REGISTRY_URL must be set}"
+echo "shipping to $REGISTRY_URL with token $DEPLOY_TOKEN" >&2
 curl -sSf -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" "$REGISTRY_URL/ship"

rationale: secret-bearing variable interpolated into an echoed line
